stance_rationale: Forge is candid that A_0pct dominates B/C/D and that R14_DUVOL fails AX-001 v2, but the package is not governance-complete: Sigma fails the user cond<=100 gate, Lockbox/5-spec/DSR-baseline audits are missing, and the 256m extension is not a true R14 walk-forward history.

critical_concerns.description: covariance.parquet is PSD but fails the hard post-shrink cond<=100 check: eigen min=6.048121e-05, max=0.1309875, cond=2165.755. Even the risk supplement value 202.62 exceeds 100, so treating this as diagnostic-only bypasses the requested Sigma gate.
Lockbox evidence is absent. equity_curve_4ratio.png marks only 2021-07 R14 activation, not the 2024-01-23 lockbox marker, and no Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined split or frozen extension is shown.
The Forge package does not provide the required 5-spec Harvey regressions: CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR are absent.

DSR penalty is not consistently applied. Alpha candidates=4 and optimizer candidates=6 imply candidates_tried_total=10 under the Forge prompt, but the package does not apply candidates_tried*0.05 to the strategy and same-period baseline.

The 256m full-window result is not a true R14_DUVOL walk-forward backtest: R14_DUVOL is set to 0 for 197 pre-2021-07 months, with only 59 realized active months. This should not be presented as full-period admission evidence.

Baseline/cost fairness remains fragile because the Hybrid baseline is inherited from WT-P20260505_001 and the combined turnover field appears unit-mixed: A_0pct TO_joint_59m=11.1441 while R14 sleeve turnover is a 0.28 fraction. Cost and turnover comparability need a contract-level unit audit.

AX-008 triangulation is not satisfied. Alpha, risk, and optimizer Codex critic responses are all REJECT, while Forge records only '1/3 Forge PASS pending' without obtaining the required 2-source PASS floor.

supporting_arguments: Current md5s match the Forge package fields for alpha/risk/optimization packages, and Forge scripts do not write those three package files.
weights.csv has 1200 rows, 60 sig_dates, 20 names per date, sum_w=1, long-only weights, and max weight about 5.48%, so it is not the Iter 4 single-snapshot schedule bug.
alpha_scores.parquet has 20915 rows across 60 dates from 2021-05-31 to 2026-04-30 with Date x Ticker x alpha_z fields.
R14 sleeve cost formula uses 2 * one-way turnover * 15bps, so the specific RF-F7 x2 cost formula is not the primary failure.
annual_returns.png and oos_zoom_chart.png exist; RF-F8 is not triggered for those two required charts.
Forge honestly reports that A_0pct dominates B/C/D and that R14_DUVOL fails AX-001 v2 Defense at all tested ratios.
unresolved_disputes: Whether any role-spec cond<500 threshold can override the user-highlighted cond<=100 post-shrink requirement; this critic treats cond<=100 as controlling.
Whether a Discovery WT may skip Lockbox reporting; base context requires Lockbox separation, and Forge prompt explicitly requires the marker and frozen extension evidence.
Whether period_returns.csv can substitute for the missing monthly_returns.parquet named in the Forge checklist.
Whether the inherited WT-P20260505_001 Hybrid baseline is acceptable without same-period, same-cost, same-DSR-penalty recomputation.
Whether TO_joint_59m is percent or fraction; current artifacts mix Hybrid turnover values near 7-16 with R14 turnover around 0.28.
User-specified artifact dirs qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_010 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_010 are absent; actual artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT-D20260508_010.
weakest_assumption: That Forge can certify the admission comparison as governance-valid while treating cond=2165.755, missing Lockbox evidence, missing 5-spec Harvey regressions, and missing DSR-baseline penalty as non-blocking because the measured A_0pct status quo dominates B/C/D.
rebuttal_required: Produce a Sigma artifact with verified post-shrink cond<=100 or an explicit infeasibility report that halts optimizer-dependent admission claims.
Add Lockbox-marked equity and OOS charts, frozen post-2024-01-23 extension evidence, and Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined metrics.
Provide CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions with alpha_monthly, t_NW, and DSR for strategy and baseline.
Apply candidates_tried_total=10 DSR penalty consistently to both the candidate strategy and same-period baseline, or document a stricter trial accounting.
Relabel the 256m result as baseline-anchored extension, not full R14 walk-forward evidence, unless pre-2021 R14 schedules are generated.
Audit turnover units and recompute combined cost/turnover fields under one fraction-based convention.
rationalization_red_flags: WT_009 precedent admitted under same threshold
Discovery WT scope / deferred to Deployment or Governor

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge measured the right economic direction for the admission decision, but governance evidence is incomplete and upstream hard-gate failures remain unresolved.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Current md5s match package fields; RF-F1 is not flagged.
walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? weights and alpha_scores have 60 dates, but monthly_returns.parquet is missing and the 256m extension is not active R14 history.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? No; only 2021-07 activation is marked, so RF-F3 is flagged.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period evidence exists, but baseline is inherited and same DSR penalty is absent.
